pages.text: The next day, they rush back to the wood. "Do it again!" said Julia.
pages.picture: the girl and dragon running into the woods, excited

pages.text: Toby looks at the branch. It lifts and drifts and lands in her hand. Then a stick. Then a tin can.
pages.picture: a branch, a stick and a tin can floating gently into the girl's hands

pages.text: "Now me," said Julia. She stands as still as a rock.
pages.picture: the girl standing very still with her eyes closed

pages.text: Toby looks at Julia. And then her feet lift off the grass.
pages.picture: the girl's feet lifting off the grass

pages.text: Up, up, up she floats! Higher than the gate. Higher than the play house.
pages.picture: the girl floating high above the backyard, the playhouse small below

pages.text: "Whoa!" said Julia. "Toby, I am floating! I am floating up high!"
pages.picture: the girl floating in the air, arms out, delighted

pages.text: Toby looks up at her, and she glides this way and that. She glides past the treetops, and the birds glide with her.
pages.picture: the girl gliding past treetops with birds, the dragon below guiding her

pages.text: She loops the loop! She spins! She dips down to the pond and zooms back up!
pages.picture: the girl doing a loop in the sky over a pond

pages.text: "This is the best day!" Julia yells. "Again! Again!"
pages.picture: the girl laughing in midair, the dragon looking up proudly

pages.text: Far away, on top of Super-Tall Peak, it is dark. In a deep cave, a big black dragon wakes up.
pages.picture: a dark cave high on a mountain at night, a huge black dragon opening its eyes

pages.text: Its claws scrape the rock. Smoke curls from its nose.
pages.picture: huge black claws scraping rock, smoke curling from nostrils in the dark

pages.text: "Toby," it hisses. "I can feel you. You can not hide from me."
pages.picture: the black dragon's glowing red eyes in the dark cave, menacing
